preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_material_consumptions WHERE created_by = 'seed:auto-fill-for-04-20'

changeSet.sql: WITH works AS (SELECT wi.id, wi.work_category_id AS cat FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.code IS NOT NULL AND wi.name_ru NOT LIKE 'QA Work%'), nt AS (SELECT w.work_item_id AS wid, wk.cat, w.branch, COALESCE(cmt.code,mt.code) AS type_code, u.code AS unit, w.norm_qty FROM work_material_consumptions w JOIN works wk ON wk.id=w.work_item_id JOIN measurement_units u ON u.id=w.material_unit_id LEFT JOIN construction_material_types cmt ON cmt.id=w.construction_material_type_id LEFT JOIN material_types mt ON mt.id=w.finishing_material_type_id WHERE w.created_by <> 'seed:auto-fill-for-04-20'), cat_typical AS (SELECT cat, branch, type_code FROM nt GROUP BY cat, branch, type_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT wid) >= 2), agg AS (SELECT branch, type_code, unit, COUNT(*) uses, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY norm_qty)::numeric,4) med FROM nt GROUP BY branch, type_code, unit), defaults AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (branch,type_code) branch, type_code, unit, med FROM agg ORDER BY branch, type_code, uses DESC), targets AS (SELECT wk.id AS work_id, ct.branch, ct.type_code, d.unit, d.med FROM works wk JOIN cat_typical ct ON ct.cat=wk.cat JOIN defaults d ON d.branch=ct.branch AND d.type_code=ct.type_code WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nt x WHERE x.wid=wk.id AND x.type_code=ct.type_code)), fan AS (SELECT t.*, p.code AS pkg FROM targets t CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('budget'),('norm'),('lux')) p(code)) INSERT INTO work_material_consumptions (work_item_id, offer_package_id, material_unit_id, branch, construction_material_type_id, finishing_material_type_id, norm_qty, waste_pct, justification_ru, justification_pl, source_type, source_doc, source_ref, created_date, created_by) SELECT f.work_id, op.id, u.id, f.branch, CASE WHEN f.branch='construction' THEN cmt.id END, CASE WHEN f.branch='finishing' THEN mt.id END, f.med, 0, 'auto-fill iz patterna kategorii; review', 'auto-fill z wzorca kategorii; review', 'auto', 'AUTO-FILL FOR-04-20', 'AUTO-FILL-FOR-04-20', NOW(), 'seed:auto-fill-for-04-20' FROM fan f JOIN offer_packages op ON op.code=f.pkg JOIN measurement_units u ON u.code=f.unit LEFT JOIN construction_material_types cmt ON f.branch='construction' AND cmt.code=f.type_code LEFT JOIN material_types mt ON f.branch='finishing' AND mt.code=f.type_code WHERE (f.branch='construction' AND cmt.id IS NOT NULL) OR (f.branch='finishing' AND mt.id IS NOT NULL);
